db_authority: DB59 frozen; no DB/source-script free text in the synthetic fresh task

prior_boundary.rule: No prior FAIL may be rewritten. This experiment validates future-only endpoint/coverage behavior.

policy_lock.selector: exact existing I4H Recovery R3 six-dimensional selector; no threshold edits
policy_lock.candidate_revision_rule: Generate each selected LOW/STANDARD scene revision once only. The exact same sealed revision bytes are reused across coverage arms; no arm-specific rewriting.

coverage_ladder.ARM_0: 0% of eligible LOW/STANDARD revisions; entire episode equals Control
coverage_ladder.ARM_50: Within LOW and STANDARD separately, sort selected scene IDs by SHA256(seed + '|' + mode + '|' + scene_id); include the first round_half_up(0.50*n) from each mode; all other selected scenes use Control bytes.
coverage_ladder.freeze: Exact arm membership and episode SHA256 values must be sealed before evaluation.

future_endpoint_candidate.name: SURFACE_RESPONSE_WITH_PROTECTION_GATE_R1
future_endpoint_candidate.candidate_primary: ARM_100 Treatment-Control mean delta across target axes >= +0.30
future_endpoint_candidate.legacy_12_axis_delta: record as secondary descriptive endpoint; legacy +0.30 is not the I4J candidate primary and R1/R2 remain FAIL under their own preregistration

coverage_hypotheses.H1: ARM_100 target-axis delta >= +0.30 while all protection/mixed gates pass.
coverage_hypotheses.H2: Target-axis response is monotonic: ARM_100 >= ARM_50 >= ARM_0.
coverage_hypotheses.H3: ARM_100 target-axis response exceeds ARM_50 by at least +0.05, indicating measurable coverage sensitivity beyond mere presence of any intervention.
coverage_hypotheses.H4: Harmful intervention rate among guard-passing LOW/STANDARD revisions <= 0.20 and ABSTAIN identity = 1.0.

evaluation.arm_masking: Random secret mapping of ARM_0/ARM_50/ARM_100 to neutral labels; only map SHA committed before scoring; map opened only after all arm scores are sealed.
evaluation.evidence_class: MASKED_SAME_AGENT__DEVELOPMENT_PREFORMAL unless independent evaluator becomes available before any scoring output

decision.HOLD: integrity/reliability or infrastructure prevents valid scoring
decision.FAIL: valid execution but any H1-H4 primary hypothesis fails
decision.endpoint_adoption: not allowed from one I4J run; at least one further fresh replication and later governance/human or independent evidence are required
